component.name: Momento
component.summary: Instant replay: save the last 15 seconds to 60 minutes

description.p: Momento is instant replay and screenshots for Linux games. Press play once and it records in the background. When something great happens, press Super+Shift+G (or Home + D-pad Down on a controller), pick how far back to go, and the clip is in your Videos folder a few seconds later.

ul.li: Save the last 15 seconds up to 60 minutes, after it happened
Clips are ready in seconds, with your game sound and, if you want, your microphone
Records just your game window, so chats and notifications stay out of your clips
A gallery to watch your clips and screenshots
Made for controllers and handhelds: no mouse needed
The bar shows up over fullscreen games on KDE Plasma, Hyprland and Sway
Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account

description.p: The first time, your desktop asks which window Momento may record, like when you share your screen in a call.

screenshot.caption: The clip bar over a game, with the 5 minute length selected
The gallery: watch your clips and screenshots right above the bar
Video settings: resolution, frame rate, quality and format

description.p: Momento 1.0: instant replay for Linux games.

ul.li: Keep the last 15, 30 or 60 minutes and save 15 seconds to 60 minutes of it
Saving runs in the background: a sound and a notification tell you when the clip is ready
Frame rate Auto matches your screen: 120 fps on a 120 Hz screen, 60 on a 60 Hz one
480p, 720p, 1080p or Native, in H.264, H.265 or AV1
A gallery to watch, browse and delete your clips and screenshots
Works with a controller: Home + D-pad Down opens the bar
